notes: `עֹשֵׂי` is an anarthrous substantival participle and takes the supplied *them that* into its own unit, headed on the lexeme-bearing *did* (rule 46).
`לַעֲבֹדַת` carries no article token, so the pointing is set aside and the preposition is preposition-only; the ASV writes no *the* before *tillage* and none is supplied (rule 29).
